summary: Applied a broad sweep of fixes across the design system, app shell, and conversation view while skipping the composer-related changes the user excluded. The work spanned three parallel subagents (design tokens/UI, app CSS/cleanup, extension UI a11y) plus hands-on edits to fix a blank-transcript defect with content-derived row-height estimates and a settle loop, cache markdown highlighting, and correct modal semantics. Test suites were repaired after failures surfaced.
decisions: Excluded findings 05 and 06 from this batch per user instruction — composer toolbar grouping and usage meter readout are deferred.

Blank-transcript defect fixed by deriving row-height estimates from message content (capped at 6000px) instead of using the flat 48/220 constants, so the virtualizer reserves enough scroll height before measurements arrive.
Added a settle loop that re-pins to the end of the conversation on each measurement pass while the virtualizer stabilises, with cancelSettle wired to onDestroy.
Cached markdown syntax-highlight results by (text, language) key to avoid re-highlighting identical code blocks during streaming rerenders.
Promoted Settings and the workspace session tree from `region` to `dialog` semantics, and updated the integration tests that asserted the old roles to match.
errors: App test run failed with 5 failures and 9 errors: a missing `settleFrame` declaration caused ReferenceErrors, three integration tests still asserted `role="region"` for the Settings/Session tree containers, and the MessageList virtual-window test hardcoded the old 22000px total height.
All three failure classes were resolved in-flight (added the declaration, updated test roles from region to dialog, reworked the virtual-window assertion to compare against the new estimator).
